about_the_game:
Transverse The Forgotten Kingdoms



On the isolated island of Solis, the history of many past kingdoms thrive and fallen throughout the years frozen in time.

Amo is a 2D top-down metroidvania action adventure on an seemingly deserted island. But not everything is as it seems. Explore old kingdoms, open seas, and the heavens to find a way off the island and learn of your past.

Game Features



  • Transverse the overworld, underworld, and the sky above to leave the island in one piece.
  • Solve the puzzles with flight, bombs, and your trusty whip throughout the journey.
  • Help stranded souls with side quests to finally rest in peace.
  • Over 700 unique rooms
  • Fight over a variety of 40 Bosses across the lands.

short_description: Amo is a top-down metroidvania, where a lost dog, Amo, gets stranded on an island. Explore the vast environments, fight through the enemies of the past, and solve the many mysteries that the island holds.
